claims.title_ko: 동일 LRS 기하의 I/VII0 군작용 중복
required_inputs: same complete physical state admissible for both actions

decision.reason: The displayed Killing fields have the VII0 brackets and unit transitivity determinant, while the same LRS metric also admits translations. The normal shear norm is nonzero whenever H_A differs from H_B.
mandatory_corrections: For a physical same-law counterexample, choose the same complete physical state admissible for both actions, including jointly invariant matter/radiation assumptions and observation law when the type domains require symmetry inheritance. Equality of metrics alone does not force equality of arbitrary matter-dependent data laws.
State local action scope or the given I x R^3 construction; do not carry both actions automatically to compact quotients or other imposed global topologies.

common spacetime symmetry for spacetime-type conclusion

decision.scope: Algebraic reconstruction of the local homogeneous spatial Lie algebra under a simple spatial-Ricci spectrum
decision.reason: For an invariant orthonormal Ricci eigenframe, D_k Ric_ij=(lambda_i-lambda_j) Gamma^j_ki determines all connection coefficients. Torsion-freeness then determines invariant-frame brackets. The homogeneity assumption makes their components constant, and the reciprocal algebra has the same isomorphism class.

Distinguish slice action from spacetime action unless preservation of time evolution and extrinsic data by the same G3 is assumed.
Record division by the spectral gap as an instability near repeated eigenvalues; the exact theorem does not imply a robust noisy classifier.

Track the T spectral-gap condition and its deterioration in near-degenerate regimes.

claims.title_ko: 전천 선도 absolute drift의 shear/vorticity 역산
equations: S=5 sym M; W=3 anti M
required_inputs: full sky or proved actual design identifiability

decision.scope: Exact full-sky leading absolute-position-drift moment inversion under the declared geodesic/Fermi-frame model
decision.reason: The primary source confirms kappa=P(sigma+omega)e in the stated limit. Second and fourth sphere moments give M=sigma/5+omega/3, and the Wolfram transcript verifies the inversion algebra.
mandatory_corrections: Specify absolute direction drift relative to an independently calibrated Fermi-Walker reference; pairwise angular separations remove a common rigid rotation and cannot by themselves recover its omega mode.
Finite-distance, finite-time, source-velocity, mask, noise and reference-frame corrections remain explicit observational inputs; catalog proper motions are not already the ideal leading coefficient.
Do not import disputed accelerated/higher-order terms or reinterpret this inversion as spatial-connection reconstruction.
decision.prohibited_upgrade: Current Gaia data already recover cosmological absolute vorticity or the Bianchi algebra.

required_inputs: same null direction across depths for stacking assertion

decision.reason: The nuisance-column inclusion and admissible compensation yield an unchanged mean and, with the fixed full noise law, an unchanged entire data law. Deterministic tensorization cannot distinguish such states.
mandatory_corrections: Retain both domain admissibility of compensation and fixed full-noise-law assumptions. A same-mean statement alone is insufficient for parameter-dependent covariance or higher noise moments.
Only claim redshift stacking fails when the same compensated null direction persists across all included depths.
decision.prohibited_upgrade: Every possible vorticity experiment is impossible, irrespective of reference calibration or redshift response.

sound outer prediction sets including remainder and nuisance
complete-state admissibility for each compatible action
claims.observable_claim: coverage theorem, no calibrated empirical instance yet

decision.scope: Coverage-preserving mean-image partial type exclusion using sound outer enclosures
decision.reason: On the simultaneous coverage event, the true observable mean belongs to both the confidence region and every sound outer image of its admissible labels. The proposed set-valued rule therefore has the stated coverage without a separate type-wise Bonferroni penalty.
mandatory_corrections: A numerical search failing to find an intersection is not a certified empty intersection; type exclusion needs a sound infeasibility or separation certificate.
If outer enclosures are data-dependent or probabilistic, prove their containment event jointly and include their failure probability in coverage. The displayed theorem assumes sound containment.
For multiple action labels, the same complete state must lie in each corresponding physical domain, not merely have the same metric.

State that this mean-image construction may fail to exploit type information present only in covariance or the rest of the data law. Non-exclusion is not realization, posterior support, or unique classification.
decision.prohibited_upgrade: A nonempty outer-set intersection proves that a physical universe of that type exists or fits the data.
